title: DSA: Binary & BST Trees
description: A tree is a non-linear data structure where nodes are arranged in a hierarchy. A Binary Tree has at most two children per node. A Binary Search Tree (BST) is a variant where the left child contains values smaller than the parent, and the right child larger, allowing for O(log n) searching.

challenges.title: BST Logic
challenges.exercise: Print 'Left small, Right large' to confirm you understand the BST ordering rule.
